answer_4.quote: we randomly selected 200 sentence pairs from the MultiNLI matched development set and presented them to three expert annotators with a combined total of 17 years of training in formal semantics and pragmatics.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered the following questions for each pair: (1) are the sentences P and H related by a presupposition/implicature relation (entails/is entailed by, negated or not); (2) what subtype of inference (e.g., existence presupposition, some, all implicature); (3) is the presupposition trigger embedded under an entailment-cancelling operator?
